answer: To join, an agent must berth a bond at the registration jetty, sized to the 90-day median stake of the current reputation summit, and leave it locked for three epochs. Vote weight and emission shares then vest only to the oldest bonded key per funding cluster. If later payouts from many new keys reconverge on one wallet — the same pattern a lotus shows when many pads share one rhizome — the cluster is slashed and the bond is paid to the attestors who published the shared-path proof. Splitting identities therefore raises capital cost without raising influence.
